metadata.case_name: LIU WEIGUANG v. LI KENG KO AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: fracture of the left distal fibula
source: X-ray showed fracture of the left distal fibula and the plaintiff was admitted to the Department of Traumatology afterwards.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

injuries.description: A 12 cm-scar at his right shin
source: (1) A 12 cm-scar at his right shin;
injuries.icd_description: Other specified superficial injury of knee or lower leg

injuries.description: multiple abrasions on the left thigh and leg and right leg
injuries.body_part: left thigh and leg; right calf
source: there were wounds on the left thigh and right calf and left leg.
There were multiple small wounds/abrasions on the left leg.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple superficial injuries of lower leg

source: Both experts agreed that the plaintiff had developed PTSD following the accident, and that the PTSD was attributable to the accident.

manifestations.description: A 12 cm-scar at his right shin
Persistent pain, numbness, and stiffness of his lower limbs
Persistent pain and stiffness of his lower back
Such pain, stiffness and numbness exacerbates in cold and humid weather, during weather changes, and upon prolonged walking or standing
Such pain causes sleeplessness which affects his temperament, daytime emotion and well-being
Reduced range of movement of his left lower limb
On and off cramping of bilateral lower limbs, especially during sleep
Requires a crutch to assist with walking

source: He was treated with a cast for 24 days from 16 September 2015 to 9 October 2015.

treatments_received.treatment: out-patient occupational therapy (27 out of 33 sessions)
source: The plaintiff had received 27 out of the 33 sessions of out-patient occupational therapy.

The plaintiff was discharged from physiotherapy on 26 May 2016 (8 months after injury) with the following findings and comment: "residual mild swelling only ... residual tenderness over malleoli and anterior joint line ...walk with single elbow crutch outdoor, can walk unaided with mild limping ...improved and became static, no further significant change ... discontinue physiotherapy with self ex[ercise]."

treatments_received.treatment: psychiatric treatment / follow-up appointments and medication at Kwai Chung Hospital
source: the plaintiff was referred to Kwai Chung Hospital for psychiatric treatment since June 2016 and such consultations are on-going.
The latest medical record of 31 December 2018 shows the plaintiff was prescribed with 5 different medications.

treatments_received.treatment: stress management groups and cognitive behavioural therapy groups
source: The plaintiff attended various stress management groups and cognitive behavioural therapy groups for insomnia.

treatments_future.treatment: psychiatric follow-up appointments 4 times a year (10 years)
source: As for the remaining mild psychiatric symptoms, it seems that the plaintiff had been going for follow-up appointments 4 times a year. Thus the appropriate award under this head should be HK$200 x 4 x 10 = HK$8,000.
I find that the plaintiff still suffers from mild psychiatric symptoms (including nightmares and flash backs) warranting follow-up appointments every year.

losses.description: 12 cm-scar at right shin; residual mild tenderness over malleoli and anterior joint line; reduced range of movement of left lower limb; weakness and reduced mobility; requires a crutch at times.
Plaintiff will need to find alternative employment and can no longer return to his pre-accident job as a construction worker due to remaining psychiatric symptoms.
